title: Step 9 — Banco de Lima accepts: PROPOSED -> ACCEPTED
description: Only counterparty_b may accept, and the originator may not accept its own proposal. Once ACCEPTED, both spokes may lock their HTLC legs.
notes: Gateway: Banco de Lima commercial-bank gateway (spoke-pen) — a different host from every other fixture in this directory. The request body is optional; POST with no body means 'accept in my own name'. on_behalf is never honoured on this user-facing route. Field divergence, verified in the delivered gateway (AcceptFXAgreement): the 200 body carries trade_id as well as tx_hash, while contracts/pvp declares tx_hash alone.
